target_customer: Fashion and other e-commerce brands and retailers that want product recommendations, search and merchandising without large behavior datasets
problem: Small and mid-size online stores lack the data to build Amazon quality recommendations. Depict models products from images and descriptions instead of customers, avoiding the cold start problem.
business_model: SaaS with performance linked pricing at launch (a cut of uplift after free A/B tests), now merchandising software subscriptions
product_category: E-commerce personalization, recommendations, search and merchandising

founders.name: Oliver Edholm
education: Left formal schooling after middle school and was homeschooled
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch (Feb 2022) says he is a Thiel Fellow, was 19 at that time, and began coding at 12. Not recorded as founding age.

founders.name: Anton Osika
founders.background_notes: From the YC page bio. Education not listed.

founders.name: Lonis Hamaili
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on the YC page; no background given. The Launch HN post and TechCrunch name only Edholm and Osika.

competitors.name: Dynamic Yield
competitors.what: Personalization platform for retailers, described as Amazon-like personalization for the rest of us
competitors.traction_then: Customers such as Under Armour and Sephora per coverage
competitors.funding_then: 38M USD Series D in November 2018, about 77M USD raised before that round per a related report

competitors.name: Klevu
competitors.what: AI search and merchandising for e-commerce stores
competitors.funding_then: Series A of about 5M EUR in 2019, 12M USD round in December 2020

technical_complexity.rationale: Building product embeddings from images and text trained on scraped e-commerce data to avoid needing behavioral data was an applied machine learning problem that a small team had to solve and run in production.

defensibility.rationale: A large scraped product dataset and models give some edge, but personalization incumbents and cloud recommendation services offered similar outputs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large platforms did not absorb Depict through early 2026 coverage. The company moved from recommendations toward AI search and merchandising for fashion.

market_need_then: In the Launch HN post, Depict argued smaller stores could not use collaborative filtering like Amazon and Netflix because they lack data, and reported 4 to 6 percent top-line uplift in A/B tests with early customers Staples Nordics and kitchentime.com.

branding.domain_note: Uses depict.ai, an AI top level domain, not the .com.

identity.visual_style: clean e-commerce software marketing site with fashion brand logos
identity.voice_and_tone: benefit led, quantified claims such as 70 percent less merchandising time

branding.brand_signature: Founder story of a teenage CEO who joined Klarna at 15, repeated in press
branding.community_and_virality: Founder interviews and podcasts feature Edholm and Osika; Osika later became CEO of Lovable.

brand_strength.rationale: Press coverage focuses on the founders and funding rather than the brand. The name is a common verb and the company page does not explain it.

pivots.from: Product recommendations for any e-commerce store
pivots.to: Search and visual merchandising for fashion e-commerce
pivots.why: Not stated; TechCrunch noted search was in beta in 2022 and the YC page now describes GPT search and merchandising for fashion.

outcome_analysis: Depict raised a 2.8M USD seed in 2021 and a 17M USD Series A led by Tiger Global in February 2022 on the strength of a data-light recommendation approach and unusually young technical founders. It added search and merchandising and now claims more than 350 brands. No later round, exit or shutdown was found, and one aggregator showing headcount decline is unverified.
notes: The Launch HN source is a blog mirror dated August 2020. Seed month not given by TechCrunch. Total raised is about 19.8M USD (sum of rounds, not stated). The Series A press release was not opened; amounts and lead come from TechCrunch and search summaries. Nosto is a likely competitor but its round dates could not be confirmed, so it is omitted from the list. Outcome search found no news about layoffs, sale or rebrand.
